conbody.p: Braking assist releases after 5 minutes. Immediately engage the brake pedal and check your surroundings.
Braking assist also releases under the following conditions:

li.p: You manually brake with sufficient power.
You release the warning by shifting to P (Park), N (Neutral), or D (Drive).

note.p: When Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist activates while you are reversing, braking control is released after 5 minutes, and the Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) is engaged.
